title: Trove browser search
description: One line of browser/searches/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a single search query issued at a single time. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the search was issued

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

query.description: the search terms, decoded (URL-unescaped, prefix stripped)

engine.description: the search engine, lowercased: "google", "bing", "duckduckgo", "safari-default" (Safari's address-bar default when the host is opaque), … — the read-time grouping axis

url.description: the full search URL, when the source has one (Takeout titleUrl; the visited Safari URL)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (a (time, query) hash for Takeout My Activity rows; a search-URL-visit hash for Safari)

extra.description: everything source-specific (Takeout header/products/locationInfos, Safari visit count, …)
